Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.88 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.46 s (within 2% of healthy). A small switching delay appears during the main pressure transient, reflecting early valve degradation.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Significant reduction in delivered volume flow at nominal electrical power indicates severe internal pump slippage.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.0 bar (within 1% of healthy). Hydraulic dampening shows early wear with mildly heightened ripple during load transitions.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 0.41 °C/min (within 1% of healthy); TS4 mean temperature 30.6 °C (within 1% of healthy). Heat exchanger maintains expected fluid cooling delta without thermal drift.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.38 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.82 s (within 1% of healthy). Directional valve actuates cleanly with no discernible switching hesitation.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.51 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 392 W·min/l (2% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 57.1 % (3% below healthy). Slight elevation in power-to-flow ratio reflects incipient volumetric efficiency loss.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.1 bar (within 1% of healthy). Marked pressure ripple and reduced peak pressure indicate severe loss of hydraulic accumulator gas pre-charge.
